Title: Task1_ins-ji-fewshot_cri-basic
instructions: You will be given the WKT format of geometries given the subject A and reference object B and some solved examples to learn from. Classify their spatial relations into one of the predicates defined by DE-9IM and the Open Geospatial Consortium. If A equals to B, there is no need to return 'within' or 'contains'. MAKE SURE the PREDICATE satisfies the dimension requirements defined by DE-9IM and OGC given Geometry Type A and Geometry Type B.
